messages:
Jen (CEO): Thanks for joining the all-hands. Quick follow-up thread for hiring/org questions that came up. I promised more clarity on the headcount buckets and team moves — ask here and we'll answer live.
Leah (People Ops): Short answer: we're reallocating ~12% of open reqs toward infra/platform and compliance for the next two quarters. Not a blanket freeze, more a prioritization shift. We'll publish the exact buckets tomorrow.
Marcus (Head of Eng): To add — SRE and infra capacity are top priority because of Dedicated/Private ramp. That means some product feature hires will be delayed, not cancelled.
Ava (ML Eng): Does this affect Applied ML hiring (evals / model ops)? We were told we'll double the eval effort this year.
Ravi (VP Product): Ava good q. Applied ML for serving/quality monitoring stays funded — the cutbacks are mostly for lower-priority greenfield product explorations.
Sofia (SWE): Any guidance on internal mobility vs external hires? If my team loses a headcount, can we backfill internally first?
Leah (People Ops): Yes — internal mobility is first priority. Process: PMs/Eng leads publish backfills to the internal job board for 3 business days before external posting. Exceptions for urgent infra roles.
Tom (SRE): How soon will the new org maps land? We need to know reporting lines for oncall rotations.
Jen (CEO): Expect a draft org map by end of next week. It will be marked "draft" and we want feedback. Oncall rota changes will be coordinated with eng-sre leads after the draft.
PeopleOpsBot: New doc posted: https://go.redwood/people-playbook (Hiring buckets + transition FAQ). cc @Leah
Leah (People Ops): Link above has the spreadsheet with headcount by function and a column for "internal redeploy recommended". We'll run office hours Thursday 3pm PT to walk through.
Marcus (Head of Eng): For managers: promotion windows unchanged. We're pausing some new manager searches unless the role supports scaling infra or revenue-critical product lines.
Ava (ML Eng): Clarify manager path for ICs who want to move to manager — any deferred timelines?
Leah (People Ops): Manager pathways continue. We will prioritize promoting from within where possible; promotion cycles remain the same.
Sofia (SWE): Will there be a hiring pause for contractors/temps too?
Leah (People Ops): Contractors will be evaluated case-by-case. We're prioritizing converting critical contractors to perm in infra/product where needed.
Tom (SRE): Any impact to Dedicated hiring commitments for customers? That customer SLAs rely on us hitting hiring/time-to-delivery targets.
Ravi (VP Product): Dedicated capacity commitments are top-tier. Customer-impacting hires and vendor spend to meet SLAs are shielded from these shifts.
Jen (CEO): High-level: this is a prioritization, not a headcount cut. We want to be surgical and transparent. If your team is impacted, your manager/Leah will reach out within 72 hours with options (redeploy, backfill, pause).
Sofia (SWE): Thanks. Can we get the metrics used to decide buckets? e.g., ARR impact, SLA risk, legal/compliance risk?
Leah (People Ops): We'll publish the decision rubric in the doc: business impact, SLA/customer risk, regulatory risk, time-to-value, and cost delta.
Ava (ML Eng): One more — does this change the FY hiring forecast we saw in the board slides?
Jen (CEO): Slight adjustment to the tail of the forecast; we'll update the slide deck and share an archived version.
Marcus (Head of Eng): If anyone needs to escalate a role that is being deprioritized but you think is mission-critical, DM me + Leah with a 1-paragraph rationale and objective metrics.
Sofia (SWE): Appreciate that. :+1:
Leah (People Ops): Office hours reminder: Thu 3pm PT (cal invite posted). We'll have slides + Q&A. If you can't make it, drop questions here or email people-ops.
Jen (CEO): Thanks everyone. We'll keep this thread updated with links. Please use reactions for quick ack so we don't flood replies. :heart:
